message.content: {"summary":"A well-structured, mostly complete mission design for GBR reef monitoring with good STK evidence and sound orbit/launch choices. To reach the top band: remove the Wikipedia citation and fix bare-URL references, show your hand calculations (e.g. J2 inclination), include software files, label figures consistently, and clarify the garbled EOL and resolution passages.","next_steps":["Replace the Wikipedia source [6] with a citable primary source, and format all references with titles, authors and access dates so in-text citations match the list","Show the J2 hand calculation (equation and working) behind your inclination-vs-altitude plot, and attach your STK scenario/software files in an appendix","Rewrite the Mission Duration & EOL section to resolve the contradictory 'without thrusters' statements and fully describe the drag sail deorbit plan; also correct the claim that low resolution 'is also desirable' for reef imaging"],"criteria":{"C1":"Strong work: your Introduction clearly covers the primary mission (fluid-lensing reef monitoring), why it is needed, the single-spacecraft justification, and users/operator/funding (CSIRO, BOM). To reach the top of the Accomplished band, deepen the customer definition - e.g. how reef managers would actually access and use the imagery.","C2":"All major requirements are addressed with good STK screenshots and access reports, and your SSO/launch rationale is sound. The next level requires higher-quality supporting evidence: include software files, show hand-calculation derivations (e.g. the J2 inclination result), fix the low-resolution contradiction, and discuss the Vega E availability risk in the design body, not just the conclusion.","C3":"Your conclusion summarises each segment and flags the Vega E risk, which is good. To move to Accomplished, go beyond restatement: critically evaluate results - is the achieved access duration adequate for the reef-monitoring requirement? What coverage or orbit trade-offs would you revisit?","C4":"Clear structure with headings and TOC, and figures have captions. For Accomplished: add consistent figure numbers (Figure 1, 2...) referenced in text, replace bare-URL references with properly formatted citations (no Wikipedia), and proofread for errors like 'is current owned' and stray parentheses."}}
